headline: Peruvian Regulator Fines Compartamos Financiera for Unsolicited Credits
summary: Indecopi's regional office in Arequipa confirmed a fine of 7.56 UIT against Compartamos Financiera for granting two unsolicited and uncontracted loans totaling 12,000 soles to a consumer.
why: Consumer protection fines highlight regulatory enforcement risks regarding lending practices and fair business conduct.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Regulatory sanctions enforce compliance standards within the financial sector.
